description.subtitle: AWS Ops Hub
description.purpose: Provide a centralized security & operations dashboard for AWS admins to audit IAM policies, manage EC2 instances, and detect anomalies.
description.tech: AWS (Lambda, S3, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, IAM), Python (Boto3), Terraform

description.subtitle: GKE Private Cluster
description.purpose: Demonstrate enterprise-grade Kubernetes provisioning with full CI/CD, WAF protection, observability, and disaster recovery.
description.tech: Terraform, GCP (GKE, Cloud Armor), GitHub Actions (WIF), Grafana, Velero (DR)

description.subtitle: Azure Integration Lab
description.purpose: Showcase full-stack Azure integration from serverless API to database to business intelligence visualization.
description.tech: Azure Functions (REST API), Azure SQL Database, Power BI, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights

description.subtitle: Real-Time IDS Alerting
description.purpose: Build a low-cost, real-time network intrusion detection system that parses Suricata logs and delivers instant alerts via a web dashboard.
description.tech: Suricata (eve.json), n8n (workflow automation), Flask (Python API), GCP Compute Engine

description.subtitle: Phishing Takedown Tool
description.purpose: Automate the investigation of suspicious domains (DNS/WHOIS/SSL) to quickly gather evidence for phishing takedown requests.
description.tech: Flask (Python SSE), Bash scripting (dig, whois, openssl), GCP

description.subtitle: GCP IAM Security Audit Agent
description.purpose: Agentic AI demo automating Google Cloud IAM security audits — natural-language requests routed through a ReAct Supervisor Agent to real GCP APIs to detect overprivileged accounts and generate structured risk reports. Decommissioned; now a static Streamlit portfolio documenting the architecture.
description.tech: Google ADK 2.2 + Gemini 2.5 Flash (Vertex AI), Streamlit 1.58, Python 3.11, Cloud Run, Terraform, GitHub Actions + Workload Identity Federation, Artifact Registry, Docker

description.subtitle: Zero-cost Edge AI (Object Detection in Browser)
description.purpose: Implement browser-based object detection using Transformers.js and DETR ONNX, leveraging WebGPU and WASM for high performance, all hosted on Netlify at no cost.
description.tech: Netlify, Transformers.js, DETR ONNX, WebGPU, WASM

description.subtitle: AI-powered K-Drama Recommendation Engine
description.purpose: Build a recommendation engine for Korean dramas using Streamlit, the Groq API with Llama models, and hosted on GCP.

description.subtitle: Real-time SQLi/XSS Blocking Demo
description.purpose: Demonstrate real-time blocking of SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks using Cloudflare WAF with custom rules and URL decoding, with traffic proxied to a GCP VM running Nginx and a Flask application.
description.tech: Cloudflare WAF (custom rules, url_decode), GCP VM, Nginx, Flask

description.subtitle: AWS IoT Core
description.purpose: Provide an end-to-end IoT solution using AWS IoT Core, including secure device communication via MQTT/mTLS, OTA updates, device shadow state management, job scheduling, a serverless backend with Lambda and API Gateway, DynamoDB for data storage, CloudFront for content delivery, infrastructure as code with Terraform, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, audit logging, and compliance with ISO 21434.
description.tech: AWS IoT Core, MQTT, mTLS, OTA, Device Shadow, Jobs, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Terraform, GitHub Actions, audit logging, ISO 21434

description.subtitle: IoT Kiosk Web Server
description.purpose: Host a web-based kiosk interface for IoT devices, built with Blazor Server and MudBlazor UI, deployed on GCP with Caddy TLS termination.
description.tech: GCP, Blazor Server, MudBlazor UI, Caddy TLS

description.subtitle: Korean Recipe WebApp
description.purpose: Develop a web application for Korean recipes using Flutter for the frontend, Firebase Firestore for database, Riverpod for state management, and Google Authentication for user login.
description.tech: Flutter WebApp, Firebase (Firestore), Riverpod, Google Auth

description.subtitle: AI-Powered Multi-Site Blog Automation Hub
description.purpose: Self-hosted n8n automation server that generates and publishes SEO-optimized blog posts and SNS content across 9 WordPress sites — orchestrating Groq Llama 3.3 70B for content generation, Tavily for live web search, SerpAPI for keyword analysis, and Google Sheets as the polling trigger.
description.tech: n8n (Community Edition), GCP (Compute Engine, us-central1-a), Docker Compose + Caddy + Cloudflare, Groq Llama 3.3 70B, Tavily, SerpAPI, Pollinations.ai (FLUX.1-schnell), Google Sheets OAuth2, WordPress REST API

description.subtitle: Orange County Public Data Platform
description.purpose: Interactive BI infographic platform visualizing Orange County, CA demographics through choropleth maps, city-level comparisons, correlation analysis, and time-series trends — community-supported, open source, and served as static files for sub-second loads.
description.tech: OCI Always Free (Ampere A1.Flex, E2.1.Micro), Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4, Leaflet + react-leaflet, Chart.js + react-chartjs-2, Zustand, Terraform + Ansible, Nginx + Cloudflare, GitHub Actions

description.subtitle: EV Registration SQL Playground
description.purpose: Interactive, read-only SQL query dashboard over Washington State electric-vehicle registration data — ingesting a public Socrata dataset into an Azure SQL star schema and exposing a browser SQL playground through a serverless API.
description.tech: Azure (SQL Database, Functions, Static Web Apps), React 18 + Vite, Python 3.11 (pymssql), Terraform (azurerm + azapi), GitHub Actions (OIDC)

description.subtitle: Arc Hybrid Governance Lab
description.purpose: Hands-on demonstration of hybrid governance as code — onboarding 2 on-premises Ubuntu servers to Azure Arc and layering on patching, compliance, tagging, and RBAC using only free Azure services, surfaced through a CI-refreshed compliance dashboard.
description.tech: Azure (Arc, Policy, Update Manager, Log Analytics, Static Web Apps), Astro 5 + Tailwind CSS 4, Terraform (azurerm), Ansible (ansible-lockdown), Lynis, Multipass, Tailscale, GitHub Actions (OIDC)

description.subtitle: Real-Time Traffic Analytics Lab
description.purpose: A fully serverless visitor analytics dashboard that records every page hit into Upstash Redis via a Java 17 Lambda backend and renders live traffic trends, path views, and recent-visit logs — demonstrating Redis-based time-series aggregation (hourly/daily/weekly rollups, HyperLogLog unique-visitor counting) on the AWS free tier.
description.tech: Java 17, AWS (Lambda + SnapStart, API Gateway, CloudFront, S3, EventBridge, CloudWatch), Upstash Redis (serverless), Maven (uber-JAR), React, Chart.js, Terraform, Cloudflare (DNS)

description.subtitle: IT & OT Compliance Framework (Manufacturing)
description.purpose: Publicly document a complete manufacturing compliance program — GDPR/CCPA privacy (Policy, RoPA, DPA, DSAR), an integrated annual IT & OT audit (10-domain checklist, CAP tracker, IEC 62443), and a TPRM vendor-risk lifecycle — as verifiable portfolio evidence built and run at Sena Technologies during IPO preparation and the Bose partnership.
description.tech: Markdown, Mermaid (architecture/flow diagrams), GitHub (version-controlled portfolio), GDPR/CCPA/CPRA & IEC 62443 frameworks, Zero-Trust (Intune + Okta) controls
